thread:
maya: quick q — when a request fails server-side schema/semantic validation, should our endpoints return 422 or 400? mobile SDKs want clear retry hints.

sam: generally 400 for syntactic/parse errors (bad JSON, unexpected type) and 422 for semantic/validation (missing required field, invalid enum). also include machine-readable retry guidance in body. :+1:

toby: streaming endpoints complicate this. midstream validation (we discover bad prompt after partial tokens) needs a midstream error envelope rather than just a final HTTP status. for unary endpoints, 422 works.

liz: heads-up — last week's mobile client treated any 4xx as terminal and suppressed retry UI. if we standardize on 422 for validation, SDKs need to check an explicit `retryable` flag.

infra-bot: current runtime emits: ```{
  "error":{"code":"INVALID_INPUT","status":422,"retryable":false,"message":"prompt contains disallowed tokens"}
}``` for model validation failures.

maya: OK. proposal: canonical error shape + decision matrix. minimal shape: ```{
  "error":{
    "type":"validation",
    "code":"INVALID_FIELD",
    "message":"field 'temperature' out of range",
    "status":422,
    "retryable":false,
    "field_errors":[{"path":"/temperature","message":"must be between 0 and 1"}]
  }
}```  keep HTTP status for transport but include `status` inside error so clients without HTTP access (webhooks) can read it.

sam: +1. small nit: prefer `retryable` to be tri-state? (true/false/absent) but boolean should be fine if we document default=false for 4xx.

toby: agree boolean is simpler. for streaming: emit midstream envelope `{"type":"error","error":{...}}` then close stream with 4xx/5xx. doc that midstream validation is terminal unless `retryable:true`.

liz: action items: maya opens PR for error shape + matrix; i'll add SDK patch to treat `retryable:true` only as override for 4xx backoff logic. mark as compatibility note for previous runtime (some older clients expect plain 422).

oncall-bot: FYI — i'll monitor canary for 4xx spikes after rollout and alert if >1% increase in validation errors during first 24h.

maya: sweet. i'll draft PR now and include a short migration note and example transforms for old clients. tagging @liz @sam for review. ETA: EOD today. :clock6:

sam: thanks — if you need a quick review ping me in thread.

liz: will test SDK behavior once PR lands.

maya: thanks all.
